title: Misunderstanding
scene: Two middle-school students face one another across a small classroom table, each puzzled but calm. An empty speech bubble between them contains only a simple gray circle. Above the left student's head a separate thought bubble contains a blue square; above the right student's head a thought bubble contains a coral triangle. These abstract mismatched shapes represent different interpretations of the same conversation. All hands rest naturally on the table. Only two students, clear separated bubbles, no text.
alt: Two puzzled students share a conversation, but their thought bubbles contain different shapes, showing that they understand the same moment differently.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: square glossary illustration for a middle-school Crew SEL pack.
